segments.name: Insurance
segments.description: Provides Medicare Advantage PPO and HMO plans to members in several states, supported by the Clover Assistant software platform.
segments.evidence: Through our Insurance segment, we provide PPO and HMO plans to Medicare Advantage members in several states.

revenueModel.text: The company earns monthly premiums from CMS under Medicare Advantage contracts, net of premiums ceded to reinsurers, plus other income such as investment income.
revenueModel.evidence: We earn premiums through our plans offered under contracts with CMS. We receive premiums from CMS on a monthly basis based on our actuarial bid and the risk-adjustment model used by CMS.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company launched Counterpart Health, Inc., a new SaaS and tech-enabled services solution for external payors and providers.
changes.evidence: During 2024, the Company launched Counterpart Health, Inc., a new Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") and Tech Enabled Services Solution to bring the power of Clover Assistant technology to external payors and providers serving the Medicare eligible population.
